description.la: Speculatio pauperis in deserto: in monte Alvernae anno 1259 scripta, de sex gradibus ascensionis in Deum per vestigia, imaginem et nomina divina, usque ad excessum mysticum in Christo crucifixo. Textus ex editione Quaracchi, ut in Bibliotheca Latina.
description.en-US: The “Speculation of the Poor Man in the Desert”, written on La Verna in 1259: six steps of the mind’s ascent to God through his footprints in the world, his image in the soul and his divine names, and the seventh, the mystical passing over in the crucified Christ. The Latin is the Quaracchi text as on The Latin Library; the English is Philotheus Boehner’s 1956 translation from the facing-page edition of the Franciscan Institute, without his introduction and commentary.
description.pt-BR: A «especulação do pobre no deserto», escrita no Alverne em 1259: seis degraus da ascensão da mente a Deus pelos seus vestígios, pela sua imagem na alma e pelos seus nomes divinos, e o sétimo, a passagem mística em Cristo crucificado.

la.editor: PP. Collegii S. Bonaventurae (Quaracchi), via The Latin Library

sources.edition: Itinerarium mentis in Deum, Quaracchi text (Opera omnia V, 1891), as transcribed on The Latin Library.
sources.description: Prologue and seven chapters; the transcription’s paragraph numbers are kept as in the source where a paragraph is numbered, and the sub-items of chapter I, 14 stay separate paragraphs.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi text of 1891 is public domain.

sources.edition: Saint Bonaventure’s Itinerarium Mentis in Deum, with an introduction, translation and commentary by Philotheus Boehner, O.F.M. (Works of St. Bonaventure II; St. Bonaventure, N.Y.: Franciscan Institute, 1956).
sources.description: Only the English of the facing-page text is imported (prologue, seven chapters); Boehner’s introduction, notes and commentary and his Latin are left out. The OCR keeps stray footnote-marker characters after some words.
sources.tierEvidence: Archive.org records “Copyright review: Public domain according to HathiTrust rights database” (not renewed).

title.la: Caput I. De gradibus ascensionis in deum et de speculatione ipsius per vestigia eius in universo
title.en-US: Chapter I. The steps in the ascent to God, and the consideration of Him through His footprints in the universe

title.la: Caput II. De speculatione dei in vestigiis suis in hoc sensibili mundo
title.en-US: Chapter II. The consideration of God in His footprints in this visible world

title.la: Caput III. De speculatione dei per suam imaginem naturalibus potentiis insignitam
title.en-US: Chapter III. The consideration of God through His image imprinted on our natural powers

title.la: Caput IV. De speculatione dei in sua imagine donis gratuitis reformata
title.en-US: Chapter IV. The consideration of God in His image reformed through the gifts of grace

title.la: Caput V. De speculatione divinae unitatis per eius nomen primarium, quod est esse
title.en-US: Chapter V. The consideration of the divine unity through its primary name, which is Being

title.la: Caput VI. De speculatione beatissimae trinitatis in eius nomine, quod est bonum
title.en-US: Chapter VI. The consideration of the most blessed Trinity in its name, which is the Good

title.la: Caput VII. De excessu mentali et mystico, in quo requies datur intellectui, affectu totaliter in deum per excessum transeunte
title.en-US: Chapter VII. The mystical transport of the mind, in which rest is given to our understanding and our affection passes over entirely to God
